name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 1 - Am 28
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 1a. Recalls that any binding or operational EU action under the European Democracy Shield requires a specific legal basis under the Treaties and must respect the principles of conferral, subsidiarity and proportionality; stresses that new technologies or evolving threats cannot in themselves create new EU competences;
